thought.text: They're client roles. Let me create them on the strassennamen client, delete the probe client, and create a test user.

reasoning_content: These are client roles (since they're under the `ClientRoles` namespace). Let's create the client roles `app-access` and `editor` on the strassennamen client.

action.command: TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/kc-token.txt) && CLIENT_ID=$(cat /tmp/client_id.txt) && for role in app-access editor; do curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients/$CLIENT_ID/roles" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"name\":\"$role\",\"description\":\"$role\"}" -w "create role $role: HTTP:%{http_code}\n"; done && echo "=== delete probe2 ===" && PROBE_ID=$(curl -s "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | jq -r '.[] | select(.clientId=="probe2") | .id') && curl -s -X DELETE "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients/$PROBE_ID" -w "delete probe2: HTTP:%{http_code}\n"
